description: This file declares the interface for rtConnection, a component managing message-based communication, including creation, destruction, message sending (both text and binary), request-response handling, and listener management. It is part of a messaging system used in the RT message framework.

methods.name: rtConnection_Create
methods.description: Creates a new rtConnection with specified application name and router configuration.

methods.name: rtConnection_CreateWithConfig
methods.description: Creates a new rtConnection from a configuration message.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message on a specified topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessageDirect
methods.description: Sends a message directly to a specific listener on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message and waits for a response.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a received request.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinary
methods.description: Sends a binary payload message on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryDirect
methods.description: Sends a binary payload directly to a specific listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryRequest
methods.description: Sends a binary request and waits for a binary response.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryResponse
methods.description: Sends a binary response to a request.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for messages matching a topic expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias to an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddDefaultListener
methods.description: Registers a default callback for message receipt.

methods.name: rtConnection_GetReturnAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the return address for this connection.

methods.name: rtConnection_Dispatch
methods.description: Performs dispatching operations; note indicates it is a leftover method from rdkb to rdkc transition.
